what.text: This page follows refugees from Somalia living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 17014 Somali refugees in France, 1.9% of all refugees from Somalia.
Kenya and Ethiopia host the most Somali refugees, followed by Uganda and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Somalia from 1990 to 1996, in 2001 to 2002 and in every year from 2006 to 2025, at war level in most of them.
From 2006 the government's opponents it records include ARS/UIC, Al-Shabaab and Hizbul Islam.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 530 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
